Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: A car rental customer registration record storing personal and contact details.

name.description: Full name of the car rental customer (2-100 characters).

dob.description: Customer date of birth formatted as DD/MM/YYYY.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when the customer is registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when the customer record is updated.

/customers/{customerId}.description: Car rental customer registration documents isolated by authenticated userId.
